items.question: What platforms can the chatbot run on?
items.answer: Websites, mobile apps, WhatsApp, Messenger and other channels can be supported.

items.question: Can it hand over to a human agent?
items.answer: Yes. Live-agent handover with full conversation context is included.

items.question: How long does it take to build a chatbot?
items.answer: Simple bots can launch in a few weeks; complex integrations take longer.

items.question: Can it connect to our systems?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with CRMs, helpdesks and databases.

items.question: How much does a chatbot cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on complexity and integrations. Share your requirements for an estimate.
